title: Making Ramen (with fresh aromatics)
summary: Person is peeling garlic over the trash bin as prep for homemade ramen; full flow covers prepping aromatics and toppings, boiling eggs and noodles, building the broth, and assembling the bowl.
source: open-set draft from 8 frames + the person's description 'making Ramen'

nodes.name: Gather ingredients and tools
nodes.instruction_novice: Get out your ramen noodles, broth or seasoning, garlic, green onions, eggs, and a pot. Keep everything within reach.
nodes.instruction_expert: Mise en place: noodles, aromatics, eggs.
nodes.end_state: Ingredients and a pot are laid out on the counter.

checks.question: Is this step done: Gather ingredients and tools?

nodes.name: Peel the garlic cloves
nodes.instruction_novice: Break cloves off the bulb and peel away the papery skin over the trash. Crush the clove lightly if the skin sticks.
nodes.end_state: Clean white garlic cloves are in hand with skins in the bin.

checks.question: Is this step done: Peel the garlic cloves?

nodes.name: Mince garlic and slice aromatics
nodes.instruction_novice: Finely chop the garlic on a cutting board. Thinly slice green onions and any ginger.
nodes.end_state: Minced garlic and sliced scallions sit in small piles on the board.

checks.question: Is this step done: Mince garlic and slice aromatics?

nodes.name: Boil eggs
nodes.instruction_novice: Lower eggs into boiling water and cook about 6 to 7 minutes for a jammy yolk. Then move them to cold water.
nodes.end_state: Eggs are cooling in a bowl of cold water.

checks.question: Is this step done: Boil eggs?

nodes.name: Sauté aromatics in pot
nodes.instruction_novice: Heat a little oil in the pot on medium and stir the garlic and ginger until fragrant, about a minute. Don't let it brown too much.
nodes.end_state: Garlic is golden and fragrant in the oiled pot.

checks.question: Is this step done: Sauté aromatics in pot?

nodes.name: Add broth and seasoning
nodes.instruction_novice: Pour in water or broth and add the seasoning packet, soy sauce, or miso. Stir and bring it to a boil.
nodes.end_state: Seasoned broth is boiling in the pot.

checks.question: Is this step done: Add broth and seasoning?

nodes.name: Cook the noodles
nodes.instruction_novice: Drop the noodles into the boiling broth or a separate pot and cook per the package, usually 2 to 4 minutes. Loosen them with chopsticks.
nodes.end_state: Noodles are soft and separated in the pot.

checks.question: Is this step done: Cook the noodles?

nodes.name: Peel and halve eggs
nodes.instruction_novice: Crack and peel the cooled eggs, then slice them in half lengthwise.
nodes.end_state: Halved eggs with soft yolks sit on the board.

checks.question: Is this step done: Peel and halve eggs?

nodes.name: Assemble the bowl
nodes.instruction_novice: Pour noodles and broth into a bowl. Top with the egg halves, green onions, and any other toppings.
nodes.end_state: A bowl of ramen topped with egg and scallions is ready.

checks.question: Is this step done: Assemble the bowl?

nodes.name: Turn off stove and clean up
nodes.instruction_novice: Switch off the burner and put the pot in the sink. Toss any remaining scraps.
nodes.end_state: Stove is off and counter is clear.

checks.question: Is this step done: Turn off stove and clean up?
